title: Subcellular visualization and quantification of cyanotoxin synthesis in cyanobacteria reveals distinct compartmentation
task: Visualize and quantify subcellular localization of cyanotoxin synthesis in cyanobacteria
key_results: Microcystins synthesized primarily in cytoplasm of unicellular Microcystis; anabaenopeptins localized to membrane regions near septa in filamentous Planktothrix; distinct modeled entities identified with stable volumes and numbers
comments: Chemoselective labeling combined with advanced imaging analysis enables compartmentalization mapping, though functional significance of these distinct biosynthetic centers remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cyanotoxin synthesis compartmentalization differs between unicellular and filamentous cyanobacteria
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—distinct subcellular localization patterns observed (cytoplasm vs. septal membrane regions)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cyanotoxin synthesis occurs in discrete biosynthetic centers
hypotheses.result: Supported—modeled entities with stable morphological properties and heterogeneous fluorescence distribution detected

title: PRMT6-mediated EZH2 arginine methylation is critical for breast cancer development
task: Determine PRMT6-mediated EZH2 methylation mechanism in breast cancer development
key_results: PRMT6 asymmetrically dimethylates EZH2 at R509, enhancing PRC2-mediated H3K27 methylation; combination PRMT6/EZH2 inhibition suppresses tumor growth; positive correlation between PRMT6 and meR509-EZH2 in patient tissues
comments: Mechanistic link between R509 methylation and PRC2 component binding is well-supported by in vitro and in vivo evidence.

model_io.model: breast cancer cell lines and mouse xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: PRMT6-mediated EZH2 R509 methylation promotes PRC2 assembly and function in tumorigenesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: R509 methylation enhances EZH2-PRC2 interactions and H3K27me3 deposition

hypotheses.hypothesis: PRMT6 and EZH2 inhibitors combined effectively suppress breast cancer growth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in mouse xenografts; positive correlation observed in patient samples

title: Silencing of METTL16 protects granulosa cells from the cisplatin-induced ferroptosis in premature ovarian failure
task: Investigate METTL16-mediated ferroptosis regulation in cisplatin-induced premature ovarian failure
key_results: METTL16 elevated in cisplatin-treated ovarian tissue and granulosa cells; METTL16 silencing inhibited iron accumulation, lipid peroxidation, and mitigated mitochondrial injury; METTL16 negatively regulated NRF2 stability via YTHDF2-mediated mRNA degradation
comments: METTL16/YTHDF2/NRF2 axis is biologically plausible but mechanistic details of m6A-dependent NRF2 regulation lack direct biochemical validation.

model_io.model: cisplatin-treated ovarian granulosa cells and POF mouse model

hypotheses.hypothesis: METTL16 promotes cisplatin-induced granulosa cell ferroptosis by suppressing NRF2 stability through YTHDF2-mediated mRNA degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: METTL16 silencing rescued NRF2 levels and ferroptosis phenotype; YTHDF2 implicated in NRF2 mRNA degradation

title: Spatiotemporal dynamics and ossification of podoplanin-positive cells in the developing femur
task: Characterize spatiotemporal dynamics and developmental functions of podoplanin-positive cells during fetal femur ossification
key_results: PDPN-positive cells emerged in bone collar concurrent with primary ossification center initiation; most expressed osterix (osteolineage marker); Pdpn knockout fetuses showed abnormal osterix-positive cell recruitment and mineral deposition
comments: Knockout phenotype demonstrates necessity but not sufficiency; detailed mechanistic characterization of PDPN function in osteoblast specification remains incomplete.

model_io.model: fetal mouse femur development and Pdpn knockout mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDPN-positive cells constitute a spatially regulated osteolineage population essential for coordinated fetal femur development
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: PDPN cells show osteolineage features and knockout impairs osterix recruitment, but specific PDPN molecular functions undefined

title: Exosomal microRNA-4800-3p in portal vein blood promotes liver metastasis in pancreatic cancer by targeting PLAA
task: Identify exosomal miR-4800-3p in portal vein blood as promoter of pancreatic cancer liver metastasis via PLAA-YTHDF2-METTL14 axis
key_results: miR-4800-3p highly expressed in portal vein blood (not peripheral blood) of PC patients; overexpression enhanced migration/invasion and EMT in vitro; PLAA identified as direct target; liver metastases showed significantly lower PLAA than lung metastases (p<0.05)
comments: Portal vein sampling is clinically relevant but mechanistic axis complexity (miR→PLAA→METTL14→GLP1R) relies on incomplete pathway documentation.

model_io.model: pancreatic cancer cell lines and liver metastasis xenograft model

hypotheses.hypothesis: exosomal miR-4800-3p in PVB targets PLAA to promote liver metastasis via reduced METTL14 ubiquitination
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: miR-4800-3p overexpression increases metastasis; PLAA identified as target; METTL14 role inferred but not directly tested

title: Harnessing Id1 as a biomarker in a plasmid reporter system for cervical cancer
task: Develop plasmid reporter system for cervical cancer screening based on Id1 promoter activity
key_results: CC cell lines showed 3-fold higher Id1 expression (HeLa 3.0±0.13, SiHa 2.9±0.27) vs fibroblasts; pId1-SEAP produced 3.9-fold more SEAP in HeLa than 3T3 cells; as few as 12,500 transfected HeLa cells generated detectable signal
comments: Proof-of-concept validation in xenograft tumors is encouraging, but clinical translation requires sensitivity/specificity optimization.

model_io.model: cervical cancer cell lines (HeLa, SiHa) and xenograft tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Id1 promoter activity is elevated in cervical cancer cells and can drive SEAP reporter expression proportionally to endogenous Id1
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CC lines showed 3-10 fold higher normalized SEAP vs non-cancer cells with pId1-SEAP

title: CQMUH-011 mitigated LPS-induced acute lung injury in neonatal rabbits
task: Evaluate protective effects of CQMUH-011 in neonatal endotoxin-induced acute lung injury
key_results: CQMUH-011 dose-dependently mitigated neurological deficits, restored blood gas balance, and reduced inflammatory lung injury comparable to dexamethasone; suppressed proinflammatory cytokines at mRNA level
comments: Transcriptomic predictions lack protein-level validation, limiting mechanistic confidence despite promising phenotypic outcomes.

model_io.model: neonatal rabbit LPS endotoxin shock model

hypotheses.hypothesis: CQMUH-011 protects lung via PI3K/AKT-dependent cytoprotection and inflammatory pathway suppression
hypotheses.result: Transcriptomic evidence supports hypothesis but lacks protein confirmation

title: The mechanism of fibronectin 1 promoting papillary thyroid cancer progression by regulating anoikis resistance
task: Role of fibronectin 1 in papillary thyroid cancer anoikis resistance and metastasis
key_results: FN1 highly expressed in PTC tissues; silencing FN1 inhibited proliferation, migration, invasion and increased anoikis; mechanism via BCL2L1/BAD axis regulation
comments: Comprehensive bioinformatics-to-validation approach identifying FN1 as therapeutic target; mechanistic insights on anti-apoptotic signaling are solid but in vitro focus.

model_io.model: Molecular validation (qRT-PCR, Western blot, cell assays)

hypotheses.hypothesis: FN1 promotes anoikis resistance and metastatic potential via BCL2L1 upregulation and BAD downregulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FN1 silencing increased anoikis rate and reduced tumorigenic phenotype

title: Catalytic mechanism for β-carotene isomerisation and substrate selectivity by the strigolactone biosynthetic enzymes D27 and D27like1
task: Elucidate catalytic mechanism and substrate selectivity of D27 enzymes in strigolactone biosynthesis
key_results: AI-guided structure prediction identified 4Fe–4S cluster in hydrophobic cavity; cavity dimensions explain isomer preference differences between D27 and D27like1
comments: Elegant integration of computational structure prediction with biochemistry; mechanism of sequential membrane-anchored catalysis is insightful.

hypotheses.hypothesis: D27 contains a 4Fe–4S cluster that facilitates single-electron transfer and cavity-induced isomerization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; structure-based mechanism explains isomer specificity of D27 versus D27like1

title: An intelligent EEG-based ensemble framework for communication assistance in Locked-In Syndrome patients
task: EEG-based P300 brain-computer interface for locked-in syndrome communication
key_results: Ensemble soft-voting classifier (SVM+RF) achieved 97.5% accuracy vs. 92.5% (SVM) and 89% (RF); outperformed baselines on precision, recall, F1-score, MCC
comments: High accuracy on controlled visual P300 task; real-world robustness and generalization across diverse LIS patients remain to be demonstrated.

inputs: EEG signals (20 subjects, visual P300 task)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wavelet-based feature extraction with soft-voting ensemble improves P300 detection robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ensemble achieved 97.5% accuracy, significantly outperforming individual classifiers

title: Antiviral activity and chemical characterization of Egyptian Ziziphus spina-christi against human respiratory viruses
task: Antiviral activity and phytochemical characterization of Ziziphus spina-christi against respiratory viruses
key_results: Leaf crude extract: H1N1 IC50 1.240 µg/ml, SARS-CoV-2 IC50 7.397 µg/ml; residual extract: MERS-CoV IC50 1.501 µg/ml; binding energies HA (H1N1) −7.48 kcal/mol, spike (SARS-CoV-2) −10.18 kcal/mol
comments: Systematic natural product investigation with docking validation; in vitro IC50 values are promising but lack cytotoxicity/selectivity data and in vivo confirmation.

inputs: fractionated samples (n-hexane, dichloromethane, ethyl acetate, aqueous)
outputs: compound identification (flavonoids, phenolics, saponins, sterols, triterpenes)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ziziphus spina-christi phytocompounds exert virucidal effects against respiratory viruses via direct binding
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; docking and antiviral assays support virucidal mechanism, but structural validation and selectivity index needed

title: A multimodal explainable artificial intelligence framework for interpretable Parkinson’s disease prediction
task: Interpretable Parkinson's disease diagnosis with explainable AI
key_results: AdaBoost accuracy 93%, precision 90%, recall 90%, F1-score 90%, AUC 0.95; ~0.75% improvement over baseline
comments: Effective integration of XAI (SHAP, LIME, ELI5) with classical ML, though validation on larger/diverse cohorts needed for clinical deployment.

model_io.model: ML ensemble (SVM, RF, k-NN, decision trees, AdaBoost)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble ML with XAI methods improves both accuracy and interpretability over single classifiers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AdaBoost + XAI achieved 93% accuracy with clinical explanations

title: AI-driven hybrid framework for enhanced pest detection and resource optimization using graph networks and deep reinforcement learning
task: Precision agriculture pest detection and resource optimization via graph networks and reinforcement learning
key_results: Yield stability improved 21.7% (±2.3%); crop health accuracy 96.8%; pest detection accuracy 95.3%; fertilizer savings 14.2%, water savings 16.4%
comments: Comprehensive multi-modal framework combining spatial graphs, AutoML, and adaptive RL; benchmarking against simpler baselines only, real farm validation pending.

inputs: raw agricultural data (IoT Smart Farm, satellite imagery)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial-temporal graph modeling with adaptive RL improves resource efficiency and yield stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework achieved 21.7% yield stability gain and 14.2–16.4% resource savings

title: Multi-class classification of plant leaf diseases using a hybrid deep neural transformer system and explainable AI techniques
task: Multi-class plant leaf disease classification with hybrid transformer and explainable AI
key_results: ResViT-152 hybrid model achieved 99.12–99.23% intratest accuracy (corn/tomato/potato); 95–96% cross-test accuracy; robust generalization across datasets
comments: Strong architectural design combining CNNs and vision transformers with good explainability; real-world field validation still required for deployment readiness.

model_io.model: Five DL architectures (InceptionNetV3, ResNet152V2, ViT, BERT, ResViT-152 hybrid)
inputs: plant leaf disease images (39,203 and 65,565 images, 18 disease classes each)

model_io.model: XAI explainability layer (feature importance, attention maps)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture (ResViT-152) outperforms single-paradigm models in accuracy and generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ResViT-152 achieved 99%+ intratest and 95%+ cross-test accuracy across crops

title: End-to-end pipeline for automated heart failure diagnosis with clinical notes using SNOMED-CT
task: Automated heart failure diagnosis from clinical notes
key_results: Abbreviation disambiguation accuracy 96.1%; SVM classification F1-score 65.3% matching medBERT.de baseline
comments: Practical NLP pipeline with SNOMED-CT grounding, though performance on small German dataset may not generalize to other languages or centers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SNOMED-CT entity linking and disambiguation can achieve competitive performance with neural baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SVM on SNOMED-CT matched medBERT.de F1-score

title: Harnessing machine learning models to repurpose drugs targeting HIV-1 integrase, protease, and reverse transcriptase
task: Drug repurposing for HIV-1 inhibitors via ensemble machine learning and molecular docking
key_results: Meta-learning integrase models: 99.14% MCC, 99.68% PR-AUC; protease: 97.20% MCC, 99.96% PR-AUC; reverse transcriptase: 97.49% MCC, 99.61% PR-AUC; identified three repurposable candidates
comments: Robust multi-target meta-learning approach with strong predictive metrics; experimental validation of candidate drugs (enoxacin, larotrectinib, pipamazine) essential before clinical use.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Meta-learning across multiple HIV-1 targets improves generalization and identifies repurposable drugs

title: Enhancing IoT security through cloud-assisted post-quantum authentication: a case study with UOV signatures
task: IoT security via cloud-assisted post-quantum UOV signatures
key_results: First cloud-delegated UOV signature scheme; honest-but-curious framework provides provably secure privacy for input/output; Raspberry Pi 5 demo shows reduced computational burden and energy
comments: Novel practical approach to PQC on edge devices; honest-but-curious model is appropriate but stronger threat models (malicious server) would strengthen security claims.

model_io.model: Cloud-assisted UOV signature protocol (Raspberry Pi 5 edge device + cloud server)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cloud delegation of UOV linear-equation solving reduces edge device computational burden while maintaining security
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Raspberry Pi 5 experiments; energy/time overhead measured vs. local computation

title: Smart beamforming and deep-learning reader for RFID systems in edge IoT
task: Chipless RFID decoding via beamforming and deep learning
key_results: Bit accuracy ≈0.98 (vs ≈0.93 ML baseline); whole-code accuracy ≈0.86 (vs ≈0.73); beamforming gain 10–12 dB; 80 MHz notch spacing on 55×32 mm² tag
comments: 1D CNN decoder is well-motivated for RCS spectra; beamforming+DL synergy is practical; limited discussion of false positive rates under interference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning decoder with beamforming outperforms probabilistic ML under low-SNR and mismatch
hypotheses.result: Bit accuracy 0.98, code accuracy 0.86; gains sustained under rotation and detuning

key_results: Novel filled function eliminates parameter tuning while maintaining differentiability; superior convergence efficiency and reliability on benchmark functions vs. existing methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter-free, differentiable filled function maintains filling properties and improves efficiency
